messages:
kevin: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A  can you confirm whether market adjustments are visible on the comp statement or only in offer letters?

marta: Market adjustments show up on the next comp statement once processed. Offers are separate for new hires. If someone has questions about their statement, they should ping peopleops-cs or the total rewards team.

lucy: For leveling calibrations, how strict are we about peer benchmarks? we came up with a case where scope is bigger but tenure is short.

marta: We weigh scope and impact higher than tenure. Benchmarks are guidance; calibration looks at demonstrated outcomes. Short tenure doesn't automatically eliminate someone. Document impact in the packet.

diego: Timeline q: when do promo packets need to be submitted for the midyear window?

marta: Midyear packets should be in 10 business days before the calibration meeting. Final approvals happen within that meeting week.

people-ops-bot: Note: new compensation statement rollout scheduled next month, details to follow. :spiral_calendar:

kevin: thx  also can managers fast-track a raise for retention reasons?

marta: We have an expedited retention review path but it requires manager + director sign-off and business justification. People Ops will review and aim for 2-week turnaround where possible.

lucy: Appreciate the clarity. Any change to promotion effective dates if someone is mid-transition between teams?

marta: We allow effective dates to align with start in the new role if both managers agree, but comp and title changes still obey payroll cutoffs.

kevin: Great, thanks. mind posting the midyear packet checklist?

marta: Will post the checklist and a short FAQ in #people-ops by EOD.
